**Risk flags:**  
- No major flags  

**Overview:**  
Seri Maju Digital Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited technology firm incorporated on 27 Feb 2003 in Kuala Lumpur, developing accounting software for small businesses. The company has a paid‑up share capital of RM 2,500,000, three directors, and its largest shareholder holds 44.2 % of the equity. Financially, revenue rose from RM 28,995,588 in 2022 to RM 56,636,796 in 2024, with profit after tax increasing from RM 2,605,767 to RM 6,750,598 over the same period. Current ratios ranged 1.08‑1.23, interest coverage stayed above 11×, and audit opinions were unqualified each year.
